purpose: Smallest paper-facing contract set that can describe a scientifically meaningful audio-tactile PPS task. It is an evidence inventory, not an automatic emulation-readiness certificate; exact current serializer paths remain a separate implementation crosswalk.
canonicalization_rules: Store one body-relative 3D position representation and derive duplicate polar or Cartesian coordinates.
For moving stimuli require geometry plus duration, or geometry plus path length and speed; derive the redundant kinematic quantity and preserve its formula.
Normalize SOAs to a declared auditory-onset anchor/sign convention; distance-at-touch anchors count only when trajectory kinematics can derive SOAs.
Use one trial-allocation rule per family and derive include flags, percentages and totals.
Keep paper evidence, derived values, low-confidence candidates, Toolkit defaults and template encodings distinguishable.
Keep trial-generation baselines separate from EEG or analysis baseline windows.

auditory_source_mode.generated: Procedural/noise-generator or synthesized source with a reproducible recipe.
auditory_source_mode.imported_asset: Recorded or authored audio file whose identity or approved substitute must be resolved.
auditory_source_mode.physical_source: A real-world sound source or apparatus produces the sound directly.
auditory_source_mode.hybrid: The executable stimulus combines generated, imported, or physical-source elements.
auditory_source_mode.unclear: The reviewed source does not distinguish the source implementation.

trajectory_motion_mode.static: One or more fixed source positions; no continuous auditory motion is synthesized.
trajectory_motion_mode.approach: The auditory source moves toward the declared body anchor.
trajectory_motion_mode.recede: The auditory source moves away from the declared body anchor.
trajectory_motion_mode.bidirectional: Approaching and receding trajectories are both experimental conditions.
trajectory_motion_mode.discrete_switching: Apparent motion is implemented by ordered physical or virtual source switches.
trajectory_motion_mode.gain_only_proxy: Looming/receding is represented by a level envelope without metric 3D motion.
trajectory_motion_mode.custom: A nonstandard or nonlinear trajectory requires an explicit ordered path.

timing_policy_type.none: The reviewed procedure explicitly uses no jitter or variable interval.
timing_policy_type.fixed: One fixed interval value is used.
timing_policy_type.discrete_set: Intervals are selected from a finite reported set.
timing_policy_type.uniform_range: Intervals are sampled from a reported continuous or stepped uniform range.
timing_policy_type.nonuniform_distribution: A named or otherwise specified nonuniform distribution is used.
timing_policy_type.pseudorandom_sequence: A constrained or predetermined pseudorandom timing sequence is used.
timing_policy_type.manual_or_event_driven: The next trial is started manually or by an external event.
timing_policy_type.custom: A study-specific timing policy requires its own rule.
timing_policy_type.not_reported: The reviewed source does not provide the timing policy.

baseline_family.none: The trial inventory explicitly contains no separate baseline/control trial family.
baseline_family.tactile_only_unspecified: Unimodal tactile trials are present but their timing relation is not fully classified.
baseline_family.tactile_only_endpoint_pre_post: Tactile-only trials occur before sound onset, after sound offset, or at trajectory endpoints.
baseline_family.tactile_only_soa_matched: Tactile-only trials match every or selected audio-tactile SOA anchors.
baseline_family.static_or_fixed_distance_expectancy_cont: A fixed/static auditory position or timing controls expectancy against the moving condition.
baseline_family.unisensory_factorial_control: Tactile-only and/or auditory-only rows are factorial multisensory controls rather than a single RT baseline ladder.
baseline_family.no_stimulation_control: No-stimulation rows or blocks provide the trial-generation control.
baseline_family.custom_mixed_control: Multiple distinct trial-control families must be represented separately.
baseline_family.analysis_only_excluded: An EEG/MEP/prestimulus analysis window is reported but is not a generated baseline trial family.

catch_family.none: The reviewed trial inventory explicitly contains no catch/no-target family.
catch_family.auditory_only_withhold: Sound is presented without the tactile target and the participant withholds a response.
catch_family.no_stimulation_withhold: No target stimulus is presented and the participant withholds a response.
catch_family.tactile_nontarget_withhold: A strong, weak, wrong-site, or otherwise designated tactile nontarget requires withholding.
catch_family.combined_no_target_families: More than one no-target/catch family is used and must be allocated separately.
catch_family.rare_target_monitoring: Most trials are target-absent while rare probes define the response task.
catch_family.auditory_only_response_target_not_catch: Auditory-only trials require a response and must remain a target/control family, not be collapsed into catch trials.
catch_family.unisensory_control_not_catch: Auditory-only or other unisensory rows are analysis controls and not behavioral catches.

allocation_mode.exact_count: An exact row/trial count is reported.
allocation_mode.repetition_factor: A repetition count is applied over an explicitly named factorial cell set.
allocation_mode.percentage_with_denominator: A percentage is reported together with a denominator or crossing rule sufficient to resolve an exact count.
allocation_mode.reported_formula: A reported arithmetic rule resolves the allocation.
allocation_mode.derived_formula: The allocation is derived from reported factors and the formula is preserved.
allocation_mode.unresolved_percentage: A percentage is reported without enough denominator/crossing information to resolve the count.
allocation_mode.not_reported: No defensible allocation rule was recovered.

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.description: Generated, imported, or physical sound identity plus an executable recipe, asset, or declared substitute; method-defining level/envelope/calibration and renderer details remain conditional. A missing private WAV requires an explicit approximation decision.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.description: Static or moving body-relative geometry plus a reconstructible timing constraint. Moving paths require duration, or path length plus speed; static sources require positions and active duration. Path length, direction and redundant speed/duration are derived.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.description: Every trial family and its ordered auditory, tactile, wait, and source-selection elements, with method-defining within-trial timing and condition intermixing.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.description: Target/no-target rule, response or explicit passive/no-response mode, device/mapping, and any method-defining response-window anchor or scoring policy. The current design serializer has no first-class response contract.
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: session_runner response policy; fixed global defaults remain an implementation gap

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.description: Explicit none, fixed, discrete, range, or custom timing policy and whether it is a foreperiod, within-sequence gap, post-sound delay, or true intertrial interval. Audio padding is not silently treated as ITI.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.description: Ordered audio-tactile onset schedule with a declared reference/sign convention, or distance-at-touch anchors only when trajectory kinematics can derive the SOAs.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.description: Tactile modality, body site/side, cue waveform/duration, and method-defining intensity/calibration or trigger mechanics needed to synthesize or route an equivalent cue.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.description: Explicit absence or a trial-generation control family (for example tactile-only, static/far, SOA-matched, endpoint, sound-offset, or custom), with timing anchor and an exact count or reconstructible allocation. EEG/analysis baselines are excluded.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.description: Explicit absence or a catch/no-target family, its expected response/withhold rule, and an exact count or reconstructible percentage with denominator/crossing rule. Auditory-only target/control rows remain distinct from catches.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.description: Repetition count or exact allocation rule and the SOA, condition and family dimensions it applies over; total trials are a derived validation, not a substitute.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.description: Block count and composition, plus method-defining pool repeat/distribution, randomization, counterbalancing and sequence constraints. A single block is an explicit complete case.
